shortDescription: Ethena said token incentives tied to USDe growth have fallen about 85% since the first airdrop in 2024. According to Foresight News, the USDe-related token incentives and inflation will drop to zero by the end of this month, after which no further distributions will be made.

title: Ethena Says USDe-Related Token Incentives Will Fall to Zero by Month-End
